contexts.text: Seduce by an outward appearance of what is just.
Nor seen His shape ()... Unless they had an idea of a human shape in relation to God, they would have none... AE 200:end.
(Such) present to themselves an idea of the Divine under a human shape.
That (this revelation) shall be made in the most natural form. Signified, Explained.
Truth Divine is not received... unless it appears in a natural form.
They are scandalized because the Divine appeared... in a despised garb.
No one can believe in and love a God whom he cannot comprehend under some form. AE 200:end.
For all things of the animus are presented in some natural form in the body; thus in the form of conjugial love when...
It is implanted in every man... to think of God under a human form.
Whatever descends from the spiritual man into the body presents itself there under a different form...
Induced to believe, by external looks, that they were not evil.
The reception (of the influx) because it is according to the form, causes every species (of plants) to remain its own species.

Every delight... is presented to the sight under various appearances... The appearances under which lascivious delights are presented are dirt, etc... The appearances under which chaste delights... are presented are gardens, etc.
A species of anxiety which they call contrition.
Societies consist of those of one genus with its species. Explained.
The appearance of a great people () = an appearance as of truth from good.
They want, under some pretence, to transfer His Divine Power to themselves. AE 1029:4.
